hypothesis: The specificity of DNA cleavage is determined by the guide RNA sequence
prediction: A mismatch between the guide RNA sequence and the target DNA sequence will result in reduced cleavage efficiency
measurement_method: In vitro DNA cleavage assays using Cas9 and guide RNAs with varying degrees of mismatch
falsification_condition: If cleavage efficiency remains high (>80%) despite multiple mismatches between the guide RNA and target DNA sequences
